description: This file contains benchmarking functions and test routines for sparse and dense matrix multiplication operations using PyTorch, including custom sparse tensor creation, benchmarking, and various test functions for different sparse matrix operations.

methods.name: create_blocked_tensor
methods.description: Creates a sparse tensor with blocked sparsity pattern, controlling sparsity level and block size.

methods.name: _test_worker
methods.description: Runs a benchmark on a test function and calculates TFLOPS.

methods.name: test_dense_dense_mm
methods.description: Tests dense matrix multiplication and benchmarks it.

methods.name: test_torch_matmul
methods.description: Tests torch.matmul for dense tensors and benchmarks it.

methods.name: test_bsr_dense_mm
methods.description: Tests sparse BSR dense matrix multiplication using custom Triton operations.

methods.name: test_bsr_dense_mm_with_meta
methods.description: Tests sparse BSR dense matrix multiplication with provided metadata.

methods.name: test_bsr_scatter_mm2
methods.description: Tests sparse BSR scatter matrix multiplication with indices data.

methods.name: test_bsr_scatter_mm6
methods.description: Tests sparse BSR scatter matrix multiplication with a different indices format.

methods.name: test_bsr_scatter_mm
methods.description: Tests sparse BSR scatter matrix multiplication with dynamically generated indices data.

methods.name: test_linear
methods.description: Tests a linear layer operation with sparse or dense tensors.
